title: SummarizedExperiment7: an experimental, agentically coded, biocspec-conformant S7 implementation
text: SummarizedExperiment7 experimental reimplementation SummarizedExperiment/RangedSummarizedExperiment data structures using S7 object system instead Bioconductor’s S4 classes. Two things make package unusual, worth stating plainly using : written agentically. class contracts, accessors, validators, tests produced AI coding agent working specification document rather hand-written line line human. code reviewed exercised, years production use Bioconductor S4 SummarizedExperiment . targets specification, S4 source. Rather porting Bioconductor’s S4 implementation, package built conform biocspec’s language-agnostic specification SummarizedExperiment (SummarizedExperiment-specification.md). specification describes contract – constructor, accessor, combining operation must guarantee – independent R, S4, particular language’s object system. biocspec also ships formal conformance test suite (summarized_experiment_conformance.yaml); package includes adapted runner (inst/conformance/run_conformance_se7.R) covering cases scope API (see ). Treat package demonstration biocspec-conformant SummarizedExperiment can built outside S4, drop-replacement Bioconductor class.

what: Comparison to Bioconductor’s own S7 migration
title: SummarizedExperiment7: an experimental, agentically coded, biocspec-conformant S7 implementation
text: Bioconductor’s SummarizedExperiment package -progress S7 migration, developed s7-migration branch lawremi/SummarizedExperiment. worth explicit effort differs package, since use S7 represent data structure different purposes. branch migrates actual Bioconductor package built S7 internally, remaining fully backward-compatible S4 object roughly one thousand Bioconductor packages depend SummarizedExperiment’s S4 API. Concretely: core object constructed via new_object(S7_object(), NAMES=..., elementMetadata=..., colData=..., assays=..., metadata=...) wrapped real S4 object new_SummarizedExperiment(); every S7 generic (rowData, colData, assays, assay, assayNames, setters) also registered formal S4 generic via setS4Generic() helper, existing setMethod()-based extensions dependent packages keep working untouched. retains complete production feature set: withDimnames=/checkDimnames= arguments, GenomicRanges/ DelayedArray/HDF5Array/Seqinfo integration, findOverlaps()/ nearest()/coverage() methods, various makeSummarizedExperimentFrom*() constructors. SummarizedExperiment7, contrast, small, standalone S7 class hierarchy S4 inheritance S4/S7 bridging. built satisfy biocspec’s language-agnostic contract rather drop-replacement, deliberately omits production features listed (see “Deliberate differences S4 original”). accessors namespaced (assay7(), colData7(), …) specifically never collide real package’s API. Three real defects fixed package development (rbind() keeping first object’s colData columns, cbind() merging rowRanges mcols(), cbind()’s range-compatibility check comparing names/length instead actual coordinates) turned match exactly canonical Bioconductor S7 migration implements three operations – useful independent validation fixes right direction.
